provenance: Rule order of `opencode debug agent build` with the config {"*":"deny","external_directory":{"<data>/opencode/tool-output/*":"deny"}}, measured on opencode 1.18.34: an external_directory deny on exactly that pattern replaces the allow opencode otherwise appends again, and nothing follows it. Rows for other permissions are omitted. <data> stands for the seat's XDG_DATA_HOME.
